headline: Fischer Medical Ventures files AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Post-AGM compliance filing submitted to the exchange
summary: Fischer Medical Ventures Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The filing completes standard post-AGM regulatory reporting requirements. For retail investors, this is routine corporate compliance without immediate financial impact on the stock.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no financial impact on your holdings
